newsitem.title: FINLAND: HELSINKI SEEN UP CAUTIOUSLY PRE-ERICSSON H1 REPORT.
newsitem.headline: HELSINKI SEEN UP CAUTIOUSLY PRE-ERICSSON H1 REPORT.

text.p: moderately higher on Thursday after Wall Street extended gains
overnight, but early trade could be hesitant ahead of Swedish
Ericsson's first-half earnings report, brokers said.
"We'll probably be up today, but not as steeply as
yesterday," one broker said, referring to Wednesday's 1.3
percent overall gains and predicting a rise of about half a
percent ahead of the Ericsson report, due around 0900 GMT.
Rivals Nokia and Ericsson tend to move in tandem.
Nokia ended at the equivalent of about 422.40 markka in New
York on Wednesday, below its 425.00 Helsinki close.
One broker predicted profit-taking in Merita after
it gained about six percent on Wednesday, ending up 1.30 at
But although there was scope for some consolidation, brokers
said the market's positive underlying tone was expected to hold
after the Dow industrials set another record high overnight.
